name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, watching races with his father every Sunday. He pursued a degree in Marketing, always aiming to combine his passion with his professional life. After graduation, he started at a small racing team, handling their social media and fan engagement. His innovative campaigns quickly gained attention, leading to opportunities with larger teams. At Caterham Motorsport, Jean-Pierre focuses on crafting compelling narratives around the team and its drivers, emphasizing authenticity and fan interaction. He believes in data-driven decisions, constantly analyzing campaign performance to optimize strategies and reach new audiences.

He has a knack for spotting emerging trends and integrating them into marketing strategies, ensuring Caterham stays ahead of the curve. Jean-Pierre is known for his calm and collected demeanor, even under pressure, making him a reliable member of the team. He is also passionate about promoting sustainability in motorsport and seeks to incorporate eco-friendly initiatives into Caterham's branding. Jean-Pierre’s experience in the world of motorsport and his dedication to pushing marketing boundaries makes him a valuable asset to Caterham Motorsport.
